questions.question: Let $A\subseteq X$. What is the complement $A^\complement$?
options: The set of elements of $X$ that are not in $A$.
The set of elements of $A$ that are not in $X$.
The set containing only the largest element of $A$.
questions.explanation: Relative to universe $X$, $A^\complement=X\setminus A=\{x\in X:x\notin A\}$.
option_explanations: Because $A\subseteq X$, no element of $A$ lies outside $X$.
Since $A\subseteq X$, the union $A\cup X$ is simply $X$, not the complement.
Complement uses membership, not an order or largest-element condition.

questions.question: What is $A\cup A^\complement$?
